_help: Timeline of the page: at most 6 rows, shown in date order (UTC). Each row: date (YYYY-MM-DD, checked against its first linked record), text, links. A link is {"label", "commit": <subject prefix>} (resolved with git log, so it survives a history rewrite), {"label", "first_commit": true}, {"label", "event": <id in events.json>} (date and URL from the server), {"label", "path": <repo file>} or {"label", "url"}. A row with "runs_field" (a RUNS.md field) or "run_row" (a RUNS.md run number) takes its date from RUNS.md and is left off the page until that field is filled.

rows.text: First commit. PREVENT risk equations matched to two published implementations. Guideline answer key written as code.
Agent, tools and verifier running on a local open-weights model. Protocol drafted.
